name: @libo11y/web
description: The libo11y browser platform for TypeScript: setup over the OpenTelemetry JS 3.x providers with a pluggable context manager, the browser resource, an OTLP/HTTP JSON transport with gzip, beacons and an IndexedDB retry queue, the consent gate, and fetch, XHR and document-load spans.

scripts.api: api-extractor run --local && api-extractor run --local -c api-extractor.internal.json && api-extractor run --local -c api-extractor.portable.json
scripts.api:check: api-extractor run && api-extractor run -c api-extractor.internal.json && api-extractor run -c api-extractor.portable.json
